verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt at docs.snowflake.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a Snowflake Documentation header and summary). The docs also expose many section-level llms.txt indexes covering Snowpark, Streamlit, Postgres, data integration, Cortex Code, ML, Native Apps, Container Services and the developer guide, giving agents structured entry points into the documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these files effectively, and evidence of full-content variants (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
